name: Ebay Used Rtx3090 Dec2026 Spike
price_basis: ASKING price, per-card. Dec-2026 PicClick scrape observed $1,430-$2,220 real asking for used RTX 3090 24GB ($1,535 3080-Ti watercooled outlier excluded) vs the Oct-2026 baseline ~$950 (record used-rtx-3090-market-oct2026-spike). +50-130% in ~8-10 weeks on DRAM+AI demand. Recorded ~$1,700 as the mid band. PERISHABLE-FIGURE STAMP. PRICE CLASS: ASKING price - the rate at which a seller advertises the item, NOT a sold/realised transaction price. OBSERVED: 2026-10-14 RE-VERIFY BY: 2027-01-14.
notes: Dec-2026 price-refresh. At $1,700+ the used 3090 is no longer the obvious budget pick it was at ~$950 in Oct; the multi-3090 70B recipe is repriced up ~2x. The Oct-2026 baseline record used-rtx-3090-market-oct2026-spike kept for history.
